messages.author: cd10ce84cd12331a
messages.subject: Shiny app disconnects after launch
parts:
I am serving a shiny app from my own server: http://mccoy.geogr.uni-jena.de:3838/patrick/hyperspectral/

However, it instantly disconnects after launch. I do not see any JS related errors. 
It works fine locally.

Some infos are generated:

The application unexpectedly exited.

shiny-server-client.min.js:1 
The application unexpectedly exited.
Diagnostic information is private. Please ask your system admin for permission if you need to check the R logs.

shiny-server-client.min.js:1 
Thu Apr 05 2018 18:35:10 GMT+0200 (CEST) [INF]: Connection closed. Info: {"type":"close","code":4503,"reason":"The application unexpectedly exited","wasClean":true}

Can somebody help me? I am so close to have a working app and now this :(

messages.subject: Re: Shiny app disconnects after launch
parts: Ok solved. By inspecting the logs I found out that I missed to remove the shiny(ui, server) call from server.R which was an artifact from splitting app.R in server.R and ui.R
